name: GW2CraftingHelper
description: A crafting-plan solver: decides whether to craft, buy on the Trading Post, buy from a vendor, or use what you already own for every ingredient in a recipe tree, with live prices.

account.details: Required for account info and coin balance

characters.details: Required to list characters and read their inventories

inventories.details: Required for bank, shared inventory, materials, and character bags

unlocks.details: Used to check which recipes your account has learned
